name: Should I build an outdoor bar or a bigger dining area first?

mainEntity.name: If I have limited space, should I prioritize an outdoor bar, dining area, or lounge zone first?
mainEntity.text: If I have limited space, should I prioritize an outdoor bar, dining area, or lounge zone first?

acceptedAnswer.text: When space is limited, the right first choice depends on how the household entertains. If most gatherings center around meals, prioritize dining space. If hosting is more casual, an outdoor bar or counter seating may be the best use of the footprint. If the space is meant for flexible socializing, a lounge zone with strong seating and a nearby surface for drinks may be the smartest starting point. In Los Angeles backyards, many homeowners try to fit all three zones and end up with none that feel comfortable. A better approach is to build one strong primary zone and leave room to add the others later. That creates a space that feels intentional, usable, and easier to expand without overcrowding the yard.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose the zone that matches how you host most often. Dining matters most for meals, a bar works best for casual gatherings, and a lounge zone is better for mixed social use. The best first investment is the feature that will get used every week.
